text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—I truly believed that path was the one 
meant for me.

text_block_list.name: TV Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
"From the Symboli household that produced 
the legendary Speed Symboli, another 
Umamusume embarks on an overseas 
campaign!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli-san! Was the decision to 
travel abroad this time made at the behest 
of the Symboli family!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Are you trying to avenge Speed Symboli's 
regrets?! Is it to realize the Symboli 
family's ideals?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
There are those who say heading overseas 
was premature—that one should establish 
their domestic standing before challenging 
the world—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Silence.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Take your small talk elsewhere. —I am 
simply here to prove the worth of a 
first-magnitude star.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Someone else's ideals or regrets have 
nothing to do with me. This is my 
decision.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: And yet—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to Speed Symboli's time, Sirius 
Symboli is—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf had a better chance than 
Sirius Symboli—

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: Sirius Symboli is—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Silence.

Before training. As I'm preparing before <chrname> 
arrives—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Are you guys still talking about 
'admiration' and 'goals'?

...I recall Sirius Symboli's words from 
before, when she told me that she was 
their goal.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Cut it out. Admiration ain't worth jack 
shit.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It is the power to execute that gives 
things meaning.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Stop obsessing over a specific 
Umamusume. That's exactly what everyone 
around you will dig into.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Comparing you to others, saying who's 
better or who's worse, finding fault 
without even knowing how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You'll be challenging it for their sake, 
right? Then don't go fabricating 
unnecessary backstories.
choice_data_list: ...Even so, I want to surpass you.
...Even so, I want to surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll just beat you down so hard that 
you won't ever want to think that again.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Brace yourself for the next Representative 
Match.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Feel it for yourself. Cry your eyes out. 
Realize just how utterly ridiculous it is 
to speak of your idle dreams.
